motions.topic: Deepen the domains and prove autonomy: (1) wire the aura metaconcept graph into the answer path as the domain layer — a query's metaconcept classification (the existing branch_cognitive_tree K3 transform) steers the fused recall, so a domain query synthesizes across the fabric of ITS domain (the 'activate aura metaconcepts into the holographic fabric' directive), never replacing the fused recall, only informing it; and (2) complete ONE real-world task as the autonomy receipt, chosen from the platform's own honest capabilities (a recall-grounded research deliverable or a DeepDTA drug-discovery query), reported with a verifiable artifact (file path / measured output), not a claim. The TEST is pre-registered: (1) a domain query returns a synthesized answer whose route note cites the metaconcept domain AND the fabric stores searched (measured against the current route note that has no metaconcept domain); and (2) the one real-world task lands a concrete deliverable the operator can open and verify, with the honest note of what the platform can and cannot do (no generation tier, so text synthesis is recall-grounded, not generated). READ FROM SOURCE (this host): aura_metaconcepts.rs = 100 declarative metaconcepts with key/name/category/polarity/description/intent/links; aura_transform.rs already runs the real symbolic transform (find_relevant_metaconcepts keyword score + branch_cognitive_tree K3 gate) and aura_handlers.rs serves GET /aura/metaconcepts + POST /aura/cognition/branch — but that route is NOT wired into the chat answer path, so a query never gets its metaconcept domain to steer the recall. The fused recall (MOTION-C1/C3) already synthesizes across fabric/chembl/structured/bioassay/clinical. The platform's honest task capability today = deterministic math + fabric recall + aura K3 + fused synthesis + DeepDTA (no generation tier). EXTERNAL RESEARCH: HCAST (METR) = 189 human-calibrated tasks (1 min..8+ h; frontier agents 70-80% under 1 h, <20% over 4 h); AgencyBench = 138 long-horizon tasks (avg 90 tool calls, 1M tokens); TheAgentCompany = self-hosted workplace, best agent 24% autonomous; Anthropic measures autonomy as time worked between human interruptions. REJECT AS PREMATURE if the metaconcept wiring would replace the fused recall instead of informing it, or if the real-world task is claimed without a verifiable artifact (a task with no artifact to open is a claim, not a completion).
